title: What Killing Your Sin Actually Looks Like
caption:
Most guys try to manage their sin instead of kill it. Different plan, different result.

Managing it means it's still alive somewhere, just quieter. Scripture never asks you to manage sin. It says put it to death, today, then again tomorrow.

Name it. Cut what feeds it. Say it out loud to one man who can actually call you on it. Then get up tomorrow and do it again, because it doesn't stay dead on its own.
